Shared genetic factors among metabolites — results from cross-trait colocalization (coloc.abf, PP.H4 > 0.8)

Three genomic loci harbor a shared causal variant across two or more of the 13 metabolites tested.

---

Locus 1: chr1:75,641,621–76,001,954 (gene: ACADM — medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase)

This is the dominant pleiotropic locus for acylcarnitine metabolism, colocalizing 4 metabolites:

  C6 (hexanoylcarnitine) and C8 (octanoylcarnitine) — PP.H4 = 0.999
  C6 and C8/C2 (ratio) — PP.H4 = 0.995
  C8 and C8/C2 — PP.H4 = 0.994
  (C3DC+C4-OH)/C10 (ratio) and C6 — PP.H4 = 0.987
  (C3DC+C4-OH)/C10 and C8 — PP.H4 = 0.983
  (C3DC+C4-OH)/C10 and C8/C2 — PP.H4 = 0.950

ACADM catalyzes the first step of mitochondrial fatty acid β-oxidation for medium-chain substrates (C4–C12). The lead SNP chr1:75663549:T:A is the top signal for C6, C8, and C8/C2 (meta p = 5.7e-30, 3.1e-27, 1.6e-29). A variant affecting ACADM activity simultaneously alters levels of C6, C8, and their ratios — a biologically expected pleiotropy.

---

Locus 2: chr1:46,792,547–46,927,183 (genes: CYP4B1, CYP4Z2P — cytochrome P450 ω-hydroxylases)

  C10:1 (decenoylcarnitine) and C6DC (C6 dicarboxylic carnitine) — PP.H4 = 0.986

The locus contains cytochrome P450 enzymes involved in fatty acid ω-hydroxylation, a pathway that produces dicarboxylic acids subsequently converted to acylcarnitines. A shared variant here links the unsaturated medium-chain acylcarnitine C10:1 with the dicarboxylic C6DC species.

---

Locus 3: chr9:129,078,980–129,215,422 (gene: CRAT — carnitine O-acetyltransferase)

  C4DC+C5-OH (ratio) and C6 (hexanoylcarnitine) — PP.H4 = 0.937

CRAT reversibly transfers short/medium-chain acyl groups between CoA and carnitine, directly interconverting acylcarnitine pools. A variant at this locus coordinately shifts C6 and the C4DC+C5-OH ratio.

---

Summary

- 8 colocalized trait pairs across 3 loci; all 8 are shared genetic factors (PP.H4 > 0.8).
- No locus showed distinct causal variants (PP.H3 dominant) — every multi-trait locus is genuinely pleiotropic.
- 7 of 13 metabolites participate in ≥1 shared factor: C6 (4 edges, most connected), C8 (3), C8/C2 (3), (C3DC+C4-OH)/C10 (3), C10:1 (1), C6DC (1), C4DC+C5-OH (1).
- 6 metabolites (C0, C4, C8:1, ORN/CIT, PRO, TYR) show independent genetic architecture — no shared causal variants with other metabolites.
- The shared genetic factors map to genes with direct biochemical roles in acylcarnitine metabolism (ACADM, CRAT) and fatty acid oxidation (CYP4B1), confirming the biological coherence of the statistical findings.

Method: Discovery + replication inverse-variance meta-analysis (N ≈ 8,000), followed by pairwise Bayesian colocalization (coloc.abf, Giambartolomei et al. 2014) via ov.genetics.cross_trait_coloc at genome-wide significance (p < 5e-8).
